messages:
alex: Spinning up a kubeadm cluster in eu-south1 for the new GPU fleet. Goal: 6 x A100 equiv nodes, private VPC, VLAN to inference subnet, and minimal public exposure. Want a short preflight + oncall handoff checklist so SREs know what to validate post-apply.

mira: OK. Quick list draft: 1) kubeadm init config + bootstrap token readiness 2) CRI and containerd config for GPU (runc vs kata?) 3) CNI (we're using Calico with IP-in-IP) 4) nvidia-device-plugin + GFD + driver sanity 5) taints/tolerations & node labels 6) metrics-server + prometheus node exporters 7) local PV / storageclass 8) LB for control-plane if multi-master

alex: Add cost bits: prefer spot/preemptible for batch nodes, but keep 2 on-demand for stable capacity + canary serving. Also confirm region GPU capacity with cloud provider before scaling.

sriram: For kubeadm, use this minimal init snippet (share in case you need exact flags):

```
kubeadm init --config=/etc/kubeadm/kubeadm-config.yaml
# kubeadm-config.yaml should include apiEndpoint, networking.podSubnet, and featureGates: "DevicePlugins=true"
```

mira: Important: set kubelet flag --container-runtime-endpoint=/run/containerd/containerd.sock and ensure containerd has nvidia/containerd-runtime configured. If using GPUDirect or SR-IOV NICs, coordinate with network team for SR-IOV policies.

robin: Network notes from infra: VLAN for inference-01 must allow MTU 9000, no NAT between GPU nodes and model-serving LB. BGP sessions will be to edge routers; Calico BGP mode tested in lab. If IP-in-IP is used, ensure iptables rules for encapsulation are allowed.

mira: Addons to apply after join:
- coredns (check forwarders)
- kube-proxy (ensure mode=ipvs)
- metrics-server
- nvidia-device-plugin DaemonSet
- gpu-feature-discovery DaemonSet
- local-path-provisioner or rook/ceph depending on customer
- cluster-autoscaler deployment with nodeSelector gpu=true for spot pool

alex: Sanity checks for oncall to run:
- kubectl get nodes --show-labels (confirm gpu=true, zone labels, taints)
- kubectl describe node <gpu-node> | grep -i "Taints\|Capacity"
- kubectl get ds -n kube-system nvidia-device-plugin -o wide
- check /var/log/nvidia-installer.log and dmesg for GPU errors

sriram: Example commands:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide | egrep "nvidia|gfd|metrics"
kubectl top nodes
nvidia-smi -L  # run on node
```

infra-bot: Reminder: open ticket with cloudops if region quota < requested GPUs. Template: "Quota increase request: eu-south1, GPUs: +6 A100".

mira: Preflight network validation: traceroute from control-plane to GPU nodes, verify MTU using iperf3 between two GPU nodes, confirm node egress via NAT gateway if needed.

alex: Handoff checklist to oncall:
- Owners: oncall rotation person + eng-infra primary (sriram)
- Run the sanity commands above and paste outputs to thread
- Deploy tiny model canary (1 request/sec) and confirm tail latency < 200ms for canary node
- If autoscaler enabled, run scale-up test: submit burst to trigger 2 spot nodes and ensure join within expected time (documented in runbook)

robin: Cost note: track GPU-hour metric in billing tags: cluster:eu-south1, pool:gpu-spot, pool:on-demand. Set alerts for >80% spend rate vs committed.

mira: Also checklist for security/compliance: ensure KMS integration for secrets, audit logging enabled to central backend, and private cluster API access only from jumpbox IPs.

alex: Thanks — I'll push the kubeadm config and a runbook page with these checks. @robin please confirm VLAN/MTU changes with network team and @infra-bot file the quota request if needed.

infra-bot: Acknowledged. Quota ticket draft created: TKT-4521.

sriram: When cluster is up, I'll run a smoke job that launches a small inference container; I'll paste results here. If anything fails, attach kubelet logs and system journal output.

mira: One last gotcha: GPU drivers sometimes conflict with AMI GPU packages. Use our golden image (ami-id: ami-0gldn-eu-south) or validate driver module versions before scaling.

alex: Perfect. Final action items for this thread: 1) alex: push kubeadm config + runbook 2) robin: network/quotas 3) sriram: smoke job post-deploy 4) mira: prepare addon manifests. We'll close thread after handoff message and first successful canary.
